codes.title: CU Boulder Facilities Management campus map, UCB Building Footprints (building names and codes)

excludeHalls.williams-village-east: Williams Village, CU Boulder's satellite residential campus on Baseline Road about 1.5 km south-east of Main Campus and linked by the Buff Bus (colorado.edu/living/williams-village); it lies outside this build's fetched map area, and walks from it to the north-west teaching core (Old Main, Hale, Guggenheim, Macky) run to about 45 minutes, so it isn't ranked on this walking map.
